title: Main Landing Gear Brake Assembly — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of one main landing gear brake assembly, including bleeding of the brake line, the wear pin datum reading and a parking brake decay check before the wheel goes back on.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one brake assembly onto a main landing gear axle, the bleeding that follows it and the checks that must be complete before the wheel is refitted.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm that the brake standard being fitted matches the standard on the other positions of the aircraft, because the anti-skid parameter set is common to all positions. Have the bleed rig connected before you start; the brake must not be left connected and unbled. The accumulator stays discharged until the bleeding is complete.
sections.procedure: Confirm that the accumulator is discharged and that the parking brake is released. Clean the axle and the torque take-out fitting and inspect them again. CAUTION: CONFIRM THAT THE BRAKE STANDARD MATCHES THE OTHER POSITIONS ON THE AIRCRAFT BEFORE YOU INSTALL IT. A MIXED STANDARD WILL NOT MATCH THE ANTI-SKID PARAMETER SET AND WILL BE REJECTED AT THE SYSTEM TEST. Position the brake trolley and offer the assembly to the axle. Engage the torque tube and install the swaged collars LN606496-25, torquing in the sequence and to the values of the illustration. Connect the hydraulic line, using a new seal, and torque the coupling. Connect the wear indication and the temperature harness connectors. Connect the bleed rig and bleed the brake until no air is seen at the return for two full minutes. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE BRAKE DURING BLEEDING AND DURING THE FIRST PRESSURISATION. A TRAPPED AIR POCKET CAN MOVE THE PISTONS WITHOUT WARNING. Charge the accumulator and pressurise the system. Read and record the wear pin datum projection with the brake pressurised. Apply the parking brake and record the pressure decay over fifteen minutes. Inspect the brake and the line for leakage.
sections.close_out: Refit the wheel and torque the axle nut to the value in the applicable task. Remove the bleed rig and the trolley. Do the brake control system test before the aircraft is released. Record the wear pin datum, the parking brake decay figure and the brake standard fitted at the position.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. All brake positions on an aircraft must carry the same heat stack standard, since the anti-skid parameter set is common.

safety_precautions: Keep the accumulator discharged until bleeding is complete.
Keep clear of the brake during bleeding and first pressurisation.
Do not leave a brake connected and unbled.
